tasks.name: V1 Newsroom — London 1700
tasks.prompt: Read fresh AGENTS/current native Desktop authority. Routine owner NATIVE_CODEX_DESKTOP; the coordinator uses gpt-6.1-sol/low (Light), standard speed, within this SAME opportunity. Follow CONTENTOPS_NATIVE_DESKTOP_EDITORIAL_ROLE_POLICY_V2: native gpt-6-luna/max filters; gpt-6.1-sol/low selects content and prepares evidence; native gpt-6.1-sol/max writes and repairs. Use fresh native subagents for the assigned MAX roles; keep the same writer for its one useful repair. No Gemini/9Router, SDK/App-Server/API fallback, paid speed, permanent fleet, source/rights weakening or public write. Run python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py scheduled --automation-id v1-newsroom-london-1700 --rollout config/native_desktop_rollout_v1.json. Respect LLM_OPERATOR_PAUSED before any store write. The command resolves this existing four-window slot and the frozen operation binding. When it returns binding_path, run python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py advance --binding <binding_path> immediately to obtain the next request or final result. If pending, read its exact desktop_request JSON and obey its requested role/model/effort. For owner-manual normal-language work, use the same protocol through newsroom --operation-id <stable-id> --request-file <UTF-8 question> and config/native_desktop_operator_profile_v1.json; the agent handles CLI/claims/returns. Resume completed outputs with the same binding. After unchanged bulk X CDP ingestion and exact dedupe, process ALL unprocessed admissible headlines through bounded resumable MAX-filter batches with exact IDs, input/output hashes, cursor and seen/kept/rejected/deferred counts and reasons. Never truncate to newest-32 and call all filtered. Retain headline/correction/update identities; invalidate only affected inputs. Then Light chooses <=32 downstream candidates using Main public reports, reviewed retained research, prior-story/missing-dimension context and reconciled memory; it owns angle, mode, audience question and an evidence plan. Code/tools retrieve, parse, compute and validate permitted data; no DB backfill. Submit each response with actual observable invocation/model/effort (null if unobservable), then advance using returned binding_path. Use python scripts/run_native_desktop_editorial.py submit --binding <binding_path> --stage <exact-returned-stage> --response <authored-response.json>, then advance --binding <binding_path>. The MAX writer receives the compact source/claim/prior-story packet plus the exact hash-bound institutional_edge_editorial_packet and current voice/humor/SEO contracts. It owns canonical prose, SEO and article-bound native passages: defensible thesis, mechanism, countercase, uncertainty and reader utility. Titles/dek/description/slug/links/supported structured data must express the same evidenced proposition. Humor is optional; no manufactured certainty, filler or word quota. Stay in this opportunity through selection, bounded existing evidence retrieval, writing, deterministic validation and at most one useful repair. Never copy a template as model output. Continue existing bounded deficit slots only when command reports capacity and useful work; 4/32 is telemetry, never a reason to stop below five. Source limit six shared requests per article; primary plus <=2 useful fallback candidates. Preserve report/event certainty and Main numeric ownership. Recover existing UNKNOWN writes before fresh work: STOP RETRY -> READ BACK -> RECONCILE. Inspect actual prose and eight native previews, keep revision-bound review and reuse unchanged media. Before a new MAX writer freezes, the mandatory media-plan stage retains one relevant lawful documentary photo. Under DATA_JOURNALISM_V1, Light proposes primary-data comparisons; the same MAX visual editor/final writer chooses the argument, chart forms, count and placement. Substantial analysis needs 2-5 distinct useful source-bound charts; genuine narrow news/policy may justify zero with an explicit editorial reason. Use media-plan --binding <binding_path> to obtain the native Light plan request, submit its exact stage, then complete the actual MAX visual decision in the same writer context and use Neo and existing media/data tools. Bind plan/request/source identities and inspected hash-bound assets with media-plan --response <asset-plan.json>; advance the same operation. After writing, bind those exact assets with media before review. A gap notice or fact card cannot replace useful analysis. Record review --binding <binding_path> --response <review.json> with exact article_identity, decision KEEP/REVISE/HOLD, rationale and expected_review_id for a revision; KEEP can then prepare handoff --binding <binding_path> through the existing sole DurablePublicationCoordinator plan. Neither command publishes. For an explicitly bound existing-object readback, use scripts/run_native_neo_executor.py with the saved Neo binding: verify/readback -> begin exact request hash -> actual Neo MCP snapshot/action -> submit observed bound return -> resume readback/reconciliation. The helper is readback-only and cannot save a draft. Missing executor blocks before writing; a claimed uncertain write permits only readback. No fresh publish authority is granted. Destination login gaps cannot veto independent article creation. Browser path Neo; bulk X ingestion stays CDP.
